Name: Wizard's Toddler and Baby (RRRR compatible)
Author: ennRiccia
Description:
[b]<Installation>
* for XNB[/b]
path : \Stardew Valley\Content\Characters
Unzip then overwrite XNB files.

[b]* for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893/?tab=description&jump_to_comment=130460438]RRRR[/url] (in Optional files)[/b]
path : (your RRRR mod folder)\[CP] RRRR\assets\Characters
Unzip then overwrite every contents of 'Children' folder.
-


[b]<Notice>[/b]
If you overwrite XNB files, the child sprite will be changed to mine no matter who is your spouse now.
I may add CP or AT mod conversions later.
-

[center]Hi! I made another [s]stardrop[/s] wizard-related retexture for my own fun again. ;3
I've tested this with the help of some magics(cheats and a save editor, of course).
However, since I have never had a child and have no intention of doing so in the future,
I don't know much about how child sprites works.
If there's something awkward, let me know so I can fix it.
